title: In Splunk SOAR versions below 8.8.0, an authenticated user with repository edit access could cause Splunk SOAR to…
description: Splunk SOAR versions prior to 8.8.0 contain a vulnerability where an authenticated user with repository edit access can write files outside the configured repository. This occurs because the software does not enforce repository paths to remain within the configured repository boundaries, allowing modification of files accessible by the Splunk SOAR user account.
